title: 🚨 NWS Moderate: Winter Weather Advisory
summary:
* WHAT...Snow and blowing snow expected. Total snow accumulations
between 3 and 6 inches. Winds gusting as high as 30 mph.

* WHERE...Atigun Pass.

* WHEN...From 10 PM this evening to 10 AM AKDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Areas of blowing snow could
reduce visibility to as low as a half mile at times.
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call...

title: 🚨 NWS Moderate: Wind Advisory
summary:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph.

* WHERE...Delta Junction.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects.
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
